source_initial_config.coordinates: A=epsilon*u; s=epsilon*(x-t/2); T=epsilon**2*t; original x,t carrier-dimensionless
source_initial_config.interpretation: Periodic 1D longitudinal temporal potential envelope; c=3/2 later-standard/stability-consistent variant; not literal printed c=1, not active spatial free-surface baseline, not full2D original.

evaluation: u(T)=IFFT(exp(T*(i*k²/8-i*epsilon*k³/16))*FFT(projected u0)); independently evaluated output times, not large integration steps
limitations: Not a whole-line decay experiment: nonzero conserved mass imposes max|u|>=sqrt(M/L).
Sparse long-time output may miss intervening maxima and does not establish a recurrence period.
Phase-aligned L2 distance is supplementary; the primary observable is ordinary envelope maximum.
Envelope-coordinate spectrum is not a NOAA surface-elevation frequency spectrum.

definitions.recurrence: Global phase only, no translation alignment; sampled local minima <0.05
definitions.steepness_bandwidth: epsilon*peak and epsilon*spectral width are formal indicators, no universal physical-validity threshold

peak_refinement.note: Dense Fourier interpolation evaluates the same trigonometric polynomial; this is a sampling check, not continuum PDE convergence.
